title: Official Code of Georgia Annotated, Title 46 (Public Utilities and Public Transportation), Chapter 9, Article 4 — Transportation of Passengers
verified_how: read the register's own table of contents in a browser: 'CHAPTER 9 Transportation of Freight and Passengers Generally (Arts. 1 — 11)' expanded to show 'Article 4 Transportation of Passengers (Pts. 1 — 3)' alongside Article 1 General Provisions (§§ 46-9-1 — 46-9-9).
notes: in_force 'unclear' for the same CAPTCHA reason. This is a genuine state-law hook for the topic — common-carrier duties and liability to passengers — and is the closest any of these five states comes to a passenger-rights statute. It does not create delay or cancellation compensation: airline delay, cancellation and denied-boarding compensation is federal and preempts state regulation (Airline Deregulation Act, 49 U.S.C. § 41713; 14 C.F.R. part 250). Flagged for human review, since a reviewer may prefer to record this topic as a gap for consistency with the other four states.
